nodes.name: MSP_DR — Data Register
nodes.description: Transmit/receive data register. Write to transmit, read to receive. In 8-bit element mode only bits [7:0] are significant; in 16-bit mode bits [15:0]; in 32-bit mode full [31:0]. Data is shifted MSB-first by default (configurable via ENDN in TCF/RCF).

fields.name: DATA
fields.raw: Transmit/receive data word. Width depends on element length setting.
fields.abstract: Transmit/receive data word. Width depends on element length setting.

nodes.name: MSP_GCR — Global Configuration Register
nodes.description: Master control register for the MSP. Controls RX/TX enable, FIFO enable, clock selection and polarity, frame sync, loopback mode, sample rate generator, frame generator, and SPI mode settings.

fields.name: RXEN
fields.raw: Receive Enable. 1=RX path enabled, 0=disabled.
fields.abstract: Receive Enable. 1=RX path enabled, 0=disabled.

fields.name: RFFEN
fields.raw: Receive FIFO Enable. 1=RX FIFO enabled, 0=disabled (direct DR access).
fields.abstract: Receive FIFO Enable. 1=RX FIFO enabled, 0=disabled (direct DR access).

fields.name: RFSPOL
fields.raw: Receive Frame Sync Polarity. 0=active high, 1=active low.
fields.abstract: Receive Frame Sync Polarity. 0=active high, 1=active low.

fields.name: DCM
fields.raw: Direct Companding Mode. 1=hardware companding/expansion active, 0=linear mode.
fields.abstract: Direct Companding Mode. 1=hardware companding/expansion active, 0=linear mode.

fields.name: RFSSEL
fields.raw: Receive Frame Sync Selection. Selects frame sync source for RX. 0=external, 1=internal (from SRG).
fields.abstract: Receive Frame Sync Selection. Selects frame sync source for RX. 0=external, 1=internal (from SRG).

fields.name: RCKPOL
fields.raw: Receive Clock Polarity. 0=data sampled on falling edge, 1=data sampled on rising edge.
fields.abstract: Receive Clock Polarity. 0=data sampled on falling edge, 1=data sampled on rising edge.

fields.name: RCKSEL
fields.raw: Receive Clock Selection. 0=external clock, 1=clock from SRG.
fields.abstract: Receive Clock Selection. 0=external clock, 1=clock from SRG.

fields.name: LBM
fields.raw: Loopback Mode. 1=TX output is looped back to RX input internally. Used for diagnostics.
fields.abstract: Loopback Mode. 1=TX output is looped back to RX input internally. Used for diagnostics.

fields.name: TXEN
fields.raw: Transmit Enable. 1=TX path enabled, 0=disabled.
fields.abstract: Transmit Enable. 1=TX path enabled, 0=disabled.

fields.name: TFFEN
fields.raw: Transmit FIFO Enable. 1=TX FIFO enabled, 0=disabled (direct DR access).
fields.abstract: Transmit FIFO Enable. 1=TX FIFO enabled, 0=disabled (direct DR access).

fields.name: TFSPOL
fields.raw: Transmit Frame Sync Polarity. 0=active high, 1=active low.
fields.abstract: Transmit Frame Sync Polarity. 0=active high, 1=active low.

fields.name: TFSSEL
fields.raw: Transmit Frame Sync Selection. 00=external FSYNC, 01=from SRG (prog), 10=from SRG (auto), 11=reserved.
fields.abstract: Transmit Frame Sync Selection. 00=external FSYNC, 01=from SRG (prog), 10=from SRG (auto), 11=reserved.

fields.name: TCKPOL
fields.raw: Transmit Clock Polarity. 0=data driven on falling edge, 1=data driven on rising edge.
fields.abstract: Transmit Clock Polarity. 0=data driven on falling edge, 1=data driven on rising edge.

fields.name: TCKSEL
fields.raw: Transmit Clock Selection. 0=external clock, 1=clock from SRG.
fields.abstract: Transmit Clock Selection. 0=external clock, 1=clock from SRG.

fields.name: TXDDL
fields.raw: TX Extra Delay. 1=one extra bit-clock delay added to TX data path. Used to compensate for pipeline delays in certain protocols.
fields.abstract: TX Extra Delay. 1=one extra bit-clock delay added to TX data path. Used to compensate for pipeline delays in certain protocols.

fields.name: SGEN
fields.raw: Sample Rate Generator Enable. 1=SRG clock output active, 0=stopped. Must be enabled before FGEN.
fields.abstract: Sample Rate Generator Enable. 1=SRG clock output active, 0=stopped. Must be enabled before FGEN.

fields.name: SCKPOL
fields.raw: SRG Clock Polarity. Selects polarity of sample rate generated clock.
fields.abstract: SRG Clock Polarity. Selects polarity of sample rate generated clock.

fields.name: SCKSEL
fields.raw: SRG Clock Selection. Selects the input clock source for the SRG. 00=APB clock (default).
fields.abstract: SRG Clock Selection. Selects the input clock source for the SRG. 00=APB clock (default).

fields.name: FGEN
fields.raw: Frame Generator Enable. 1=frame sync generation active. SRG must be enabled first (SGEN=1).
fields.abstract: Frame Generator Enable. 1=frame sync generation active. SRG must be enabled first (SGEN=1).

fields.name: SPICKM
fields.raw: SPI Clock Mode. Selects SPI clock phase/polarity when MSP is used in SPI-compatible mode. 00=normal.
fields.abstract: SPI Clock Mode. Selects SPI clock phase/polarity when MSP is used in SPI-compatible mode. 00=normal.

fields.name: SPIBME
fields.raw: SPI Burst Mode Enable. 1=SPI burst transfer mode enabled.
fields.abstract: SPI Burst Mode Enable. 1=SPI burst transfer mode enabled.

nodes.name: MSP_TCF — Transmit Configuration Register
nodes.description: Configures the transmit protocol: element and frame lengths for both phases, data type (companding), endianness, data delay, frame sync behavior, and byte swap mode. Supports single or dual phase operation.

fields.name: P1ELEN
fields.raw: Phase 1 Element Length. Encodes the transmit data element width. 000=8-bit, 001=10-bit, 010=12-bit, 011=14-bit, 100=16-bit, 101=20-bit, 110=24-bit, 111=32-bit.
fields.abstract: Phase 1 Element Length. Encodes the transmit data element width. 000=8-bit, 001=10-bit, 010=12-bit, 011=14-bit, 100=16-bit, 101=20-bit, 110=24-bit, 111=32-bit.

fields.name: P1FLEN
fields.raw: Phase 1 Frame Length. Number of elements per frame in phase 1 minus 1. E.g., 0=1 element, 15=16 elements, 63=64 elements.
fields.abstract: Phase 1 Frame Length. Number of elements per frame in phase 1 minus 1. E.g., 0=1 element, 15=16 elements, 63=64 elements.

fields.name: DTYP
fields.raw: Data Type / Compression Mode. Controls hardware companding. 00=linear (no companding), 10=µ-law, 11=A-law. Bit 10 may also encode frame sync polarity in certain configurations (driver ambiguity).
fields.abstract: Data Type / Compression Mode. Controls hardware companding. 00=linear (no companding), 10=µ-law, 11=A-law. Bit 10 may also encode frame sync polarity in certain configurations (driver ambiguity).

fields.name: ENDN
fields.raw: Endianness / Bit Order. 0=MSB first (big-endian), 1=LSB first (little-endian) for transmit data.
fields.abstract: Endianness / Bit Order. 0=MSB first (big-endian), 1=LSB first (little-endian) for transmit data.

fields.name: DDLY
fields.raw: Data Delay. Number of bit-clock cycles between frame sync and first data bit for transmit. 00=0 cycles, 01=1 cycle (I2S uses 1), 10=2 cycles, 11=3 cycles.
fields.abstract: Data Delay. Number of bit-clock cycles between frame sync and first data bit for transmit. 00=0 cycles, 01=1 cycle (I2S uses 1), 10=2 cycles, 11=3 cycles.

fields.name: FSIG
fields.raw: Frame Sync Ignore. Controls behavior on unexpected frame sync edge. 0=abort current transfer on unexpected FSYNC, 1=ignore unexpected FSYNC and continue.
fields.abstract: Frame Sync Ignore. Controls behavior on unexpected frame sync edge. 0=abort current transfer on unexpected FSYNC, 1=ignore unexpected FSYNC and continue.

fields.name: P2ELEN
fields.raw: Phase 2 Element Length. Same encoding as P1ELEN. Only used when P2EN=1 (dual-phase mode).
fields.abstract: Phase 2 Element Length. Same encoding as P1ELEN. Only used when P2EN=1 (dual-phase mode).

fields.name: P2FLEN
fields.raw: Phase 2 Frame Length. Number of elements per frame in phase 2 minus 1. Only used when P2EN=1.
fields.abstract: Phase 2 Frame Length. Number of elements per frame in phase 2 minus 1. Only used when P2EN=1.

fields.name: P2SM
fields.raw: Phase 2 Start Mode. 0=phase 2 starts immediately after phase 1, 1=phase 2 starts on next frame sync edge.
fields.abstract: Phase 2 Start Mode. 0=phase 2 starts immediately after phase 1, 1=phase 2 starts on next frame sync edge.

fields.name: P2EN
fields.raw: Phase 2 Enable (dual-phase mode). 0=single-phase protocol, 1=dual-phase protocol. PCM typically uses dual-phase; I2S uses single-phase.
fields.abstract: Phase 2 Enable (dual-phase mode). 0=single-phase protocol, 1=dual-phase protocol. PCM typically uses dual-phase; I2S uses single-phase.

fields.name: TBSWAP
fields.raw: Byte/Half-word Swap for transmit data. Controls byte ordering within data words.
fields.abstract: Byte/Half-word Swap for transmit data. Controls byte ordering within data words.

nodes.name: MSP_RCF — Receive Configuration Register
nodes.description: Configures the receive protocol: element and frame lengths for both phases, data type (expansion), endianness, data delay, frame sync behavior, and byte swap mode. Mirrors TCF layout for RX path.

fields.name: P1ELEN
fields.raw: Phase 1 Element Length. Encodes the receive data element width. 000=8-bit, 001=10-bit, 010=12-bit, 011=14-bit, 100=16-bit, 101=20-bit, 110=24-bit, 111=32-bit.
fields.abstract: Phase 1 Element Length. Encodes the receive data element width. 000=8-bit, 001=10-bit, 010=12-bit, 011=14-bit, 100=16-bit, 101=20-bit, 110=24-bit, 111=32-bit.

fields.name: P1FLEN
fields.raw: Phase 1 Frame Length. Number of elements per frame in phase 1 minus 1. E.g., 0=1 element, 15=16 elements, 63=64 elements.
fields.abstract: Phase 1 Frame Length. Number of elements per frame in phase 1 minus 1. E.g., 0=1 element, 15=16 elements, 63=64 elements.

fields.name: DTYP
fields.raw: Data Type / Expansion Mode. Controls hardware companding. 00=linear (no companding), 10=µ-law, 11=A-law. Bit 10 may also encode frame sync polarity in certain configurations (driver ambiguity).
fields.abstract: Data Type / Expansion Mode. Controls hardware companding. 00=linear (no companding), 10=µ-law, 11=A-law. Bit 10 may also encode frame sync polarity in certain configurations (driver ambiguity).

fields.name: ENDN
fields.raw: Endianness / Bit Order. 0=MSB first (big-endian), 1=LSB first (little-endian) for receive data.
fields.abstract: Endianness / Bit Order. 0=MSB first (big-endian), 1=LSB first (little-endian) for receive data.

fields.name: DDLY
fields.raw: Data Delay. Number of bit-clock cycles between frame sync and first data bit for receive. 00=0 cycles, 01=1 cycle (I2S uses 1), 10=2 cycles, 11=3 cycles.
fields.abstract: Data Delay. Number of bit-clock cycles between frame sync and first data bit for receive. 00=0 cycles, 01=1 cycle (I2S uses 1), 10=2 cycles, 11=3 cycles.

fields.name: FSIG
fields.raw: Frame Sync Ignore. Controls behavior on unexpected frame sync edge. 0=abort current transfer on unexpected FSYNC, 1=ignore unexpected FSYNC and continue.
fields.abstract: Frame Sync Ignore. Controls behavior on unexpected frame sync edge. 0=abort current transfer on unexpected FSYNC, 1=ignore unexpected FSYNC and continue.

fields.name: P2ELEN
fields.raw: Phase 2 Element Length. Same encoding as P1ELEN. Only used when P2EN=1 (dual-phase mode).
fields.abstract: Phase 2 Element Length. Same encoding as P1ELEN. Only used when P2EN=1 (dual-phase mode).

fields.name: P2FLEN
fields.raw: Phase 2 Frame Length. Number of elements per frame in phase 2 minus 1. Only used when P2EN=1.
fields.abstract: Phase 2 Frame Length. Number of elements per frame in phase 2 minus 1. Only used when P2EN=1.

fields.name: P2SM
fields.raw: Phase 2 Start Mode. 0=phase 2 starts immediately after phase 1, 1=phase 2 starts on next frame sync edge.
fields.abstract: Phase 2 Start Mode. 0=phase 2 starts immediately after phase 1, 1=phase 2 starts on next frame sync edge.

fields.name: P2EN
fields.raw: Phase 2 Enable (dual-phase mode). 0=single-phase protocol, 1=dual-phase protocol. PCM typically uses dual-phase; I2S uses single-phase.
fields.abstract: Phase 2 Enable (dual-phase mode). 0=single-phase protocol, 1=dual-phase protocol. PCM typically uses dual-phase; I2S uses single-phase.

fields.name: TBSWAP
fields.raw: Byte/Half-word Swap for receive data. Controls byte ordering within data words.
fields.abstract: Byte/Half-word Swap for receive data. Controls byte ordering within data words.

nodes.name: MSP_SRG — Sample Rate Generator Register
nodes.description: Configures the sample rate generator which produces the bit clock and frame sync. SCKDIV divides the input clock. FRWID sets the active frame sync width. FRPER sets the total frame period in clock cycles.

fields.name: SCKDIV
fields.raw: Sample Clock Divider. The input clock (APB or external) is divided by (SCKDIV+1) to produce the bit clock. Range: 0-1023. Bit clock = f_input / (SCKDIV+1). Default APB clock is 48 MHz.
fields.abstract: Sample Clock Divider. The input clock (APB or external) is divided by (SCKDIV+1) to produce the bit clock. Range: 0-1023. Bit clock = f_input / (SCKDIV+1). Default APB clock is 48 MHz.

fields.name: FRWID
fields.raw: Frame Width. Sets the number of bit-clock cycles during which frame sync is active. For I2S: 15 (16 cycles), for PCM: 0 (1 cycle).
fields.abstract: Frame Width. Sets the number of bit-clock cycles during which frame sync is active. For I2S: 15 (16 cycles), for PCM: 0 (1 cycle).

fields.name: FRPER
fields.raw: Frame Period. Total number of bit-clock cycles per frame. For I2S stereo: 31 (32 cycles), for PCM: 255 (256 cycles). Frame frequency = bit_clock / (FRPER+1).
fields.abstract: Frame Period. Total number of bit-clock cycles per frame. For I2S stereo: 31 (32 cycles), for PCM: 255 (256 cycles). Frame frequency = bit_clock / (FRPER+1).

nodes.name: MSP_FLR — Flag Register
nodes.description: Read-only status flags showing RX/TX busy states and FIFO fullness. Used by the driver to poll FIFO status during flush operations.

fields.name: RBUSY
fields.raw: Receive Busy. 1=RX is currently active receiving data.
fields.abstract: Receive Busy. 1=RX is currently active receiving data.

fields.name: RFE
fields.raw: Receive FIFO Empty. 1=RX FIFO is empty, no data available to read.
fields.abstract: Receive FIFO Empty. 1=RX FIFO is empty, no data available to read.

fields.name: RFU
fields.raw: Receive FIFO Full. 1=RX FIFO is full, no room for new data.
fields.abstract: Receive FIFO Full. 1=RX FIFO is full, no room for new data.

fields.name: TBUSY
fields.raw: Transmit Busy. 1=TX is currently active transmitting data.
fields.abstract: Transmit Busy. 1=TX is currently active transmitting data.

fields.name: TFE
fields.raw: Transmit FIFO Empty. 1=TX FIFO is empty. Used during flush to confirm all data has been transmitted.
fields.abstract: Transmit FIFO Empty. 1=TX FIFO is empty. Used during flush to confirm all data has been transmitted.

fields.name: TFU
fields.raw: Transmit FIFO Full. 1=TX FIFO is full, cannot accept more data.
fields.abstract: Transmit FIFO Full. 1=TX FIFO is full, cannot accept more data.

nodes.name: MSP_DMACR — DMA Control Register
nodes.description: Enables DMA request generation for RX and TX paths. When enabled, the MSP asserts DMA request lines instead of generating CPU interrupts for data transfer.

fields.name: RDMAE
fields.raw: Receive DMA Enable. 1=DMA requests generated for RX data available.
fields.abstract: Receive DMA Enable. 1=DMA requests generated for RX data available.

fields.name: TDMAE
fields.raw: Transmit DMA Enable. 1=DMA requests generated for TX FIFO space available.
fields.abstract: Transmit DMA Enable. 1=DMA requests generated for TX FIFO space available.

nodes.name: MSP_IMSC — Interrupt Mask Set/Clear Register
nodes.description: Controls which interrupt sources are enabled (unmasked). Writing 1 to a bit enables the corresponding interrupt; writing 0 masks it. The driver uses this to enable RX/TX service and error interrupts.

fields.name: RSIP
fields.raw: Receive Service Interrupt. Set when RX FIFO has data ready to be read (FIFO threshold reached).
fields.abstract: Receive Service Interrupt. Set when RX FIFO has data ready to be read (FIFO threshold reached).

fields.name: ROEI
fields.raw: Receive Overrun Error Interrupt. Set when RX FIFO overflows — new data arrives but FIFO is full. Indicates data loss.
fields.abstract: Receive Overrun Error Interrupt. Set when RX FIFO overflows — new data arrives but FIFO is full. Indicates data loss.

fields.name: RFEI
fields.raw: Receive Frame Sync Error Interrupt. Set on unexpected frame sync during receive, if FSIG=0 (abort mode).
fields.abstract: Receive Frame Sync Error Interrupt. Set on unexpected frame sync during receive, if FSIG=0 (abort mode).

fields.name: RFSI
fields.raw: Receive Frame Sync Interrupt. Set on each receive frame sync edge.
fields.abstract: Receive Frame Sync Interrupt. Set on each receive frame sync edge.

fields.name: TSIP
fields.raw: Transmit Service Interrupt. Set when TX FIFO has space available (below threshold).
fields.abstract: Transmit Service Interrupt. Set when TX FIFO has space available (below threshold).

fields.name: TUEI
fields.raw: Transmit Underrun Error Interrupt. Set when TX FIFO is empty but transmission is active. Indicates the output data may be corrupted.
fields.abstract: Transmit Underrun Error Interrupt. Set when TX FIFO is empty but transmission is active. Indicates the output data may be corrupted.

fields.name: TFEI
fields.raw: Transmit Frame Sync Error Interrupt. Set on unexpected frame sync during transmit, if FSIG=0 (abort mode).
fields.abstract: Transmit Frame Sync Error Interrupt. Set on unexpected frame sync during transmit, if FSIG=0 (abort mode).

fields.name: TFSI
fields.raw: Transmit Frame Sync Interrupt. Set on each transmit frame sync edge.
fields.abstract: Transmit Frame Sync Interrupt. Set on each transmit frame sync edge.

nodes.description: Shows raw (pre-mask) interrupt status for all 8 interrupt sources. Each bit indicates whether the corresponding event occurred, regardless of the IMSC mask setting.

nodes.name: MSP_MCR — Multichannel Control Register
nodes.description: Controls multichannel (TDM) operation for RX and TX. Enables per-channel selection and RX comparison mode. Multichannel is only supported in single-phase mode. Up to 4x32=128 channels can be enabled via TCE/RCE.

fields.name: RMCEN
fields.raw: Receive Multichannel Enable. 1=RX multichannel mode active. Only valid in single-phase mode.
fields.abstract: Receive Multichannel Enable. 1=RX multichannel mode active. Only valid in single-phase mode.

fields.name: RMCSF
fields.raw: Receive Multichannel Sub-frame. Selects RX multichannel start phase configuration.
fields.abstract: Receive Multichannel Sub-frame. Selects RX multichannel start phase configuration.

fields.name: RCMPM
fields.raw: Receive Comparison Mode. Controls data comparison on received channels. 00=disabled, 10=match on non-equal, 11=match on equal.
fields.abstract: Receive Comparison Mode. Controls data comparison on received channels. 00=disabled, 10=match on non-equal, 11=match on equal.

fields.name: TMCEN
fields.raw: Transmit Multichannel Enable. 1=TX multichannel mode active. Only valid in single-phase mode.
fields.abstract: Transmit Multichannel Enable. 1=TX multichannel mode active. Only valid in single-phase mode.

fields.name: TNCSF
fields.raw: Transmit Next Channel Sub-frame. Selects TX multichannel start phase configuration.
fields.abstract: Transmit Next Channel Sub-frame. Selects TX multichannel start phase configuration.

nodes.name: MSP_RCV — Receive Comparison Value Register
nodes.description: 32-bit comparison value for multichannel RX data matching. When RCMPM is enabled, incoming data is compared against (data & RCM) == RCV. Cleared to 0 on MSP close.

fields.name: CVAL
fields.raw: Comparison Value. Data received on enabled channels is compared to this value (masked by RCM) to determine match/non-match condition.
fields.abstract: Comparison Value. Data received on enabled channels is compared to this value (masked by RCM) to determine match/non-match condition.

nodes.name: MSP_RCM — Receive Comparison Mask Register
nodes.description: 32-bit mask for the receive comparison operation. Only bits set to 1 in this register participate in the comparison with RCV. Cleared to 0 on MSP close.

fields.name: CMASK
fields.raw: Comparison Mask. Bit-level mask applied before comparing received data against the comparison value in RCV.
fields.abstract: Comparison Mask. Bit-level mask applied before comparing received data against the comparison value in RCV.

nodes.name: MSP_TCE0 — Transmit Channel Enable 0 Register
nodes.description: 32-bit channel enable mask for TX multichannel group 0. Each bit enables one of 32 channels (channels 0-31). Only effective when TMCEN=1 in MCR. Cleared on MSP close.

fields.name: TCE0
fields.raw: TX channel enable bits for channels 0-31. 1=channel active, 0=channel muted.
fields.abstract: TX channel enable bits for channels 0-31. 1=channel active, 0=channel muted.

nodes.name: MSP_TCE1 — Transmit Channel Enable 1 Register
nodes.description: 32-bit channel enable mask for TX multichannel group 1. Each bit enables one of 32 channels (channels 32-63). Only effective when TMCEN=1 in MCR. Cleared on MSP close.

fields.name: TCE1
fields.raw: TX channel enable bits for channels 32-63. 1=channel active, 0=channel muted.
fields.abstract: TX channel enable bits for channels 32-63. 1=channel active, 0=channel muted.

nodes.name: MSP_TCE2 — Transmit Channel Enable 2 Register
nodes.description: 32-bit channel enable mask for TX multichannel group 2. Each bit enables one of 32 channels (channels 64-95). Only effective when TMCEN=1 in MCR. Cleared on MSP close.

fields.name: TCE2
fields.raw: TX channel enable bits for channels 64-95. 1=channel active, 0=channel muted.
fields.abstract: TX channel enable bits for channels 64-95. 1=channel active, 0=channel muted.

nodes.name: MSP_TCE3 — Transmit Channel Enable 3 Register
nodes.description: 32-bit channel enable mask for TX multichannel group 3. Each bit enables one of 32 channels (channels 96-127). Only effective when TMCEN=1 in MCR. Cleared on MSP close.

fields.name: TCE3
fields.raw: TX channel enable bits for channels 96-127. 1=channel active, 0=channel muted.

nodes.name: MSP_ITCR — Integration Test Control Register
nodes.description: Controls integration test mode. When ITEN is set, normal operation is overridden and the test logic takes control. TESTFIFO enables direct FIFO access via the test data register (TSTDR). Used during TX FIFO flush.

fields.name: ITEN
fields.raw: Integration Test Enable. 1=test mode active, normal operation suspended.
fields.abstract: Integration Test Enable. 1=test mode active, normal operation suspended.

fields.name: TESTFIFO

fields.abstract: Test FIFO. 1=FIFO test mode, allows read/write via TSTDR register. Driver sets both ITEN+TESTFIFO to flush TX FIFO during close.

nodes.name: MSP_ITIP — Integration Test Input Register

fields.abstract: Integration test input data.

nodes.name: MSP_ITOP — Integration Test Output Register

fields.abstract: Integration test output data.

nodes.name: MSP_TSTDR — Test Data Read Register

fields.name: TDATA

fields.abstract: Test data read from TX FIFO. Only valid when ITCR.TESTFIFO=1.

nodes.name: Core MSP Registers
nodes.description: Core operational registers: data, configuration, sample rate, flags, DMA, interrupts, multichannel, channel enables, I/O delay, and test registers.

nodes.name: Identification Registers
nodes.description: ARM PrimeCell peripheral and component identification registers. Read-only, factory-programmed. Used to identify the IP block type and revision.

nodes.name: I2S Protocol Mode
nodes.description: I2S (Inter-IC Sound) protocol support. Single-phase, MSB-first, 1-bit data delay, frame sync active-low. Default element length 32-bit, stereo frame of 32 bit clocks. This is the primary audio protocol mode.

nodes.name: PCM Protocol Mode
nodes.description: PCM (Pulse Coded Modulation) protocol support. Dual-phase, MSB-first, 0 data delay, frame sync active-high. Default 16-bit elements, 256-clock frame period.

nodes.name: PCM Companded Mode
nodes.description: Companded PCM mode with hardware µ-law or A-law compression/expansion. Single-phase, 8-bit elements. Used for voice-band telephony.

nodes.name: Hardware Companding
nodes.description: Hardware companding support via the DTYP field in TCF/RCF. Supports linear, µ-law, and A-law modes. Controlled by DCM bit in GCR.

nodes.name: DMA Transfer
nodes.description: DMA-based data transfer using the DMACR register. TX and RX DMA can be enabled independently. The driver enables DMA for both directions during the open sequence. DMA base address is MSP_DR (offset 0x00).

nodes.name: TX/RX FIFO
nodes.description: Transmit and receive FIFOs. 32 entries deep (based on flush loop limit). FIFO enable controlled via RFFEN/TFFEN in GCR. Status available via FLR register (empty/full flags).

nodes.name: Configurable Data Sizes
nodes.description: Supports 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 20, 24, and 32-bit element sizes. Configured via P1ELEN/P2ELEN in TCF/RCF. Data size affects DR access width.

nodes.name: Clock Generation
nodes.description: Built-in sample rate generator (SRG) produces bit clock and frame sync. Input clock is APB (48 MHz default). Bit clock = f_input / (SCKDIV+1). Frame sync generated with configurable width and period.

nodes.name: Frame Synchronization
nodes.description: Frame sync generation and detection. Configurable polarity (active high/low), width (FRWID), and period (FRPER). Unexpected frame sync can abort transfer or be ignored (FSIG bit).

nodes.name: External Clock Input
nodes.description: MSP can use external bit clock and frame sync instead of internal SRG. Selected via RCKSEL/TCKSEL and RFSSEL/TFSSEL bits in GCR.

nodes.name: Multichannel / TDM
nodes.description: Time-Division Multiplexing (TDM) support. Up to 128 channels (4 x 32-bit enable masks in TCE0-3 and RCE0-3). Only supported in single-phase mode. Per-channel enable/disable for both TX and RX independently.

nodes.name: RX Data Comparison
nodes.description: Receive data comparison mode. Compares incoming data against RCV value (masked by RCM). Can generate interrupt on match or non-match. Used for channel identification in TDM applications.

nodes.name: Dual Phase Protocol
nodes.description: Dual-phase protocol support via P2EN bit. Phase 1 and phase 2 can have independent element/frame lengths. Phase 2 can start immediately after phase 1 or wait for next frame sync (P2SM bit).

nodes.name: Loopback Mode
nodes.description: Internal loopback mode (LBM bit in GCR). TX output is routed back to RX input internally. Used for self-test and diagnostics without external connections. Also used transiently during shutdown to drain FIFOs.

nodes.name: SPI Compatibility
nodes.description: SPI-compatible mode with configurable clock mode (SPICKM) and burst mode (SPIBME). Allows MSP to communicate with SPI peripherals.

nodes.name: Interrupt System
nodes.description: 8 interrupt sources: RX/TX service, RX overrun, TX underrun, RX/TX frame sync, RX/TX frame sync error. Controlled by IMSC register. Status in RIS (raw) and MIS (masked). Clear via ICR.

nodes.name: Multiple MSP Instances
nodes.description: DB8500 SoC has 4 MSP instances: MSP0 at 0x80123000, MSP1 at 0x80124000, MSP2 at 0x80117000, MSP3 at 0x80125000. Each is independently configurable. The driver manages a per-instance state machine (IDLE→CONFIGURED→RUNNING).

nodes.name: I/O Delay Configuration
nodes.description: Configurable I/O pad delay via IODLY register. Platform-specific value written during open sequence.

nodes.name: Configurable Endianness
nodes.description: Byte order configurable per direction (TX/RX) via ENDN bit in TCF/RCF. Also supports byte/half-word swap via TBSWAP field.

nodes.name: Integration Test Mode
nodes.description: Integration test control via ITCR register. Test mode enables direct FIFO access through TSTDR and test I/O via ITIP/ITOP. Used by driver to flush TX FIFO during shutdown sequence.

nodes.name: MSP Open / Configure
nodes.description: Full MSP initialization: configure GCR (clocks, FIFO, loopback, sync selection), set protocol descriptors (TCF/RCF), configure SRG (bit clock divider, frame width/period), optionally configure multichannel (MCR, TCE0-3, RCE0-3, RCV, RCM), enable DMA (DMACR), set IODLY, enable frame generator, flush both FIFOs, set state to CONFIGURED.

nodes.name: MSP Trigger Start/Stop
nodes.description: ALSA trigger handler. On START/RESUME/PAUSE_RELEASE: sets TXEN or RXEN in GCR to begin data flow. On STOP/SUSPEND/PAUSE_PUSH: calls disable_msp_tx/rx which clears enable bits, disables DMA, and masks interrupts.

nodes.name: MSP Close / Shutdown
nodes.description: MSP shutdown sequence. Disables TX/RX (with loopback-assisted drain if both directions active), disables DMA and interrupts. If both directions now idle: disables SRG + frame gen, zeroes GCR, TCF, RCF, DMACR, SRG, MCR, RCM, RCV, and all TCE/RCE registers. Sets state to IDLE.

nodes.name: TX FIFO Flush
nodes.description: Drains TX FIFO using integration test mode. Enables TX, then sets ITCR (ITEN+TESTFIFO), reads TSTDR in a loop until TFE flag is set or limit (32 reads) reached, then clears ITCR and restores GCR.

nodes.name: RX FIFO Flush
nodes.description: Drains RX FIFO by temporarily enabling RX, then reading DR in a loop until RFE (RX FIFO Empty) flag is set or limit (32 reads) reached, then restores original GCR value.

nodes.name: Bit Clock Setup
nodes.description: Configures the sample rate generator. Disables SRG, calculates SCKDIV from f_inputclk / (frame_freq * clocks_per_frame), sets FRWID and FRPER, writes SRG register, waits 100µs, enables SRG, waits another 100µs. The 100µs delays allow the PLL to stabilize.
